initial.title: [v0.92.1][PROV-A] Shared provider inference profiles
initial.goal: Produce one shared provider inference-profile contract with deterministic Ollama materialization.
initial.required_outcome: One shared provider inference-profile contract with deterministic Ollama materialization. Schema, materialization, invalid-profile, last-known-good, and redaction checks pass.
authority_boundary: Issue completion is exactly one shared provider-profile contract; provider-specific checks are evidence inputs.
No adjacent sprint or provider authority
operator_constraints: No paid cloud or provider mutation
No secrets, legal instruments, auth codes, or recovery factors in Git
initial.task_boundary: Issue completion is exactly one shared provider-profile contract; provider-specific checks are evidence inputs.
deliverables: One shared provider inference-profile contract with deterministic Ollama materialization.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Profiles bind provider model and bounded parameters
AC-2: Invalid profiles fail before activation
AC-4: Credentials prompts and private payloads are excluded
initial.plan_summary: Reconcile the issue boundary, produce the single PROV-A deliverable, validate it, and obtain exact-head review.

steps.action: Reconcile dependencies and freeze the exact issue-local denominator.
Produce the bounded primary deliverable without widening authority.
Run every planned PVF lane and retain bounded redacted evidence.
Obtain exact-head review and prepare a truthful publication handoff.

invariants: Issue completion is exactly one shared provider-profile contract; provider-specific checks are evidence inputs.
Schema, materialization, invalid-profile, last-known-good, and redaction checks pass.
No secret or private material in Git
risks: Private material would enter a profile
stop_conditions: Private material would enter a profile

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove last known good for PROV-A.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on any stop condition, authority ambiguity, secret exposure, incomplete denominator, or non-proving validation.
review_prompts: Does the implementation stay inside the declared unit boundary?
Does every acceptance criterion have proving evidence?
Are operator-only actions and private material kept outside Git?
initial.review_scope: PROV-A declared paths, acceptance criteria, PVF evidence, and operator boundary only.
